title: 11 Up
tagline: Pairs that make 11. Clear the table.
blurb: Three stacks predealt, like the bar-top. Peel two that make 11 or a matching face. Next Card drops into a hole and costs. Clear the stacks for a bonus and a new deal. Two rounds.

copy.playing: Tap two open cards that make 11, or two of the same face.
copy.full: Table full. Pair or take score.
